story.text: # 🔭 The V7 Research Strands

The model's seventh pass, at **headline level**. Each strand is a reading in progress: named here, kept in the atlas, and published in full only when its note is ready. Nothing on this page extends a proven result; conjecture status lives in the register.

story.title: Observer-patch holography
story.text: An outside physics framework read against the model: where public agreement and private ambiguity line up with the Swordsman/Mage split, and where the analogy must not be carried.

story.title: Merkle Tree Certificates × the Hold
story.text: Batch-signed certificates as a reading of what the Star holds: one signed root, many inclusion proofs.

story.title: Unlinkable inference
story.text: Private inference as a Swordsman concern: requests that cannot be linked back to the asker.

story.title: What the verifier reads
story.text: A hash-signature board as a lens on disclosure: what a verifier must read, and what it never needs.

story.title: Research letters on the reconstruction ceiling
story.text: Read against outside mathematics, the strict R < 1 is **declared, not derived**: the capacity deficit is a premise a deployment declares and attests.

story.title: The declared deficit
story.text: The ruling itself, as it now stands in the dragon skill and the model page.

story.title: Embeddings and measured disclosure
story.text: How much of a text an embedding gives back, treated as measured disclosure rather than assumed privacy.

story.title: Evidence, authority and effects
story.text: A loop for agent actions: what evidence an action carries, who authorised it, and what effect it may have.
